correctness.rationale: The reverse-preimage coordinate change is exact: b becomes identity and a copies one scheduled membership bit. The dependency graph is a q-cycle, so first-infection times are forced at 1+(m-1)p; harmful visits to the initial endpoint force b. This proves both the free-position count and independence. Exact BFS checks all coprime pairs through q=13 and symbolic checks extend through q=100.

value.rationale: Shortest reset length is the central extremal invariant of this classical two-parameter family. The exact multiplicity distinguishes rigid and highly degenerate optimum behavior without changing the threshold and exposes a simple scheduled-copy mechanism behind all optimum words. The formula is uniform in both coprime parameters and specializes to an explicit exponential multiplicity for the classical Wielandt automata.
